rubric: Each listed Topic must be directly supported by the Evidence. Uncovered means there is another generalizable subject outside these Topics. A validated clear set is correct only if it equals every expected Topic and uncovered is false. An abstention counts toward the coverage denominator.

topics.label: Food cold chain
topics.description: Maintaining safe refrigeration temperatures while transporting or storing food.

topics.label: Delivery scheduling
topics.description: Planning or changing delivery appointments, driver routes and arrival windows.

topics.label: Musical tuning
topics.description: Adjusting the pitch of musical instruments or comparing it with a reference.

cases.text: The milk remained below four degrees Celsius throughout the trip.
Check the temperature logger in the frozen pea shipment before unloading.
Ice cream must stay frozen even during transfers between the van and the depot.
The dispatcher moved the Thursday drop-off to Friday at noon.
Send the westbound driver to the hill depot before the waterfront stop.
The recipient chose the eight-to-ten arrival slot for the parcel.
The violist matched the open A string to the oboe's reference pitch.
Turn the guitar's tuning peg until the two tones stop beating.
We raised the pitch of the harpsichord a semitone before rehearsal.
Move the salmon delivery to dawn and keep the fish below four degrees Celsius during transit.
The driver rescheduled the piano delivery for Wednesday. The tuner then brought each string to its reference pitch.
Measure the chilled cheese temperature, then move its delivery appointment to midday.
Refrigerate the yogurt throughout transit and segregate its packaging waste for recycling.
Reschedule the courier for Tuesday, then reconcile the outstanding supplier invoice.
Tune the mandolin against a reference note and replace the torn upholstery on its case.

Pitch the chilled-drink advertising campaign to the client on Monday.

Tune the oven controller so its temperature reading matches the calibrated probe.

Pick a later delivery window, keep the yogurt cold, and replace the cracked warehouse roof tiles.
